text_simplified: Parents must teach their children salah and accustom them to it from a young age, while observing rifq (gentleness) and kindness in guidance. The parents should also be a good example for their children in performing acts of worship. Teaching salah strengthens religious values and discipline in the child.

review_defects.english: Teaching Salah to Children with Rifq and the Example of the Parents
review_defects.why: The English title adds 'of the Parents', which is not present in the Arabic title. The Arabic only says 'with gentleness and example' without specifying whose example.
